read_department_reports.description: Read per-department metric rows from the department reports export for one reporting period. Optionally restrict to named departments or to a category (circuit / core).

read_kpi_definitions.description: Read approved institution-wide KPI definitions: formula, unit, target value and the authority the target comes from.

read_external_benchmark.description: Call the external benchmark API for a KPI's published peer median. Coverage is partial; many KPIs have no benchmark.

filter_rows.description: Filter previously-read department rows by an exact field value. Errors if the filter matches nothing, so an empty subset can never be silently averaged.

compute_kpi.description: Compute one approved KPI over a set of department rows, using the KPI's registered formula. Returns the value plus per-department drill-down evidence.
compute_kpi.returns: {kpi_id, name, value, unit, formula, n_departments, inputs_used, evidence: [...], source_system, figure_status} | {error}

compare_to_target.description: Compare a computed KPI value against its approved target and return the variance, the status band, and a rounding warning if a rounded figure would hide a miss.
compare_to_target.returns: {kpi_id, value, target, target_source, variance, pct_of_target, status, rounding_warning} | {error}

compute_variance.description: Compute the difference between a computed KPI value and any reference figure (a peer benchmark, a prior year). Exists so that no arithmetic is ever done in prose.

draft_notification.description: DRAFT a notification for leadership. It is never sent: the return value is a draft pending human approval. Every finding must carry its source or the call is rejected.
draft_notification.returns: {status: 'DRAFT - NOT SENT', audience, subject, body, requires_approval_from} | {error}
